environment: Linux; Java 17; Maven 3.9.11; X11 inherited assigned role DISPLAY and XAUTHORITY; Mesa software rendering; isolated synthetic offline profile. Browser playtesting does not apply to this native Java/OpenGL game.

implementation.ship: 23-block stepped hull, red waterline, 18 ribbed containers, aft accommodation and glazed bridge, funnel, mast, navigation lights and wake
implementation.routes: Automatic west-to-east neighboring coastal port links, at most 16 ports, pair distance at most 2048 blocks. Offshore anchorages are 34 blocks south of each port entrance. Entire axis-aligned corridor plus 13-block hull/turn clearance must be generated open ocean. Ship speed 4 blocks/sec; dwell 8 sec at each port. Round trips use persisted/replicated city elapsed time; no wire/save format change.
implementation.scope: Visible cargo traffic; no economic cargo transfer or ship boarding was requested or added.

setupNotes: Copied non-secret Maven dependency cache into assigned worktree target/m2 because shared /tmp cache is read-only in the sandbox.
Initial test run could not create a temp directory; rerun used assigned worktree target/tmp.
An extended native attempt clicked the open menu over the world placement point; corrected harness camera focus to keep target at viewport center, then restarted.
publication: Pending controller staging, commit and push. No commit, push, merge or deployment performed by developer.

playtest.entry: Playtest: production Main on Linux X11/Mesa, inherited assigned display and authentication, isolated synthetic offline city. Native menu clicks exercised placement and camera views; real city time exercised the complete outbound voyage, destination dwell and start of return voyage.

steps.step: Choose Port on inland land, then click the site
steps.expected: No port building is created; notice explains open ocean requirement
steps.observed: No port building created; open-ocean notice asserted

steps.step: Choose Technical college level 3 and place it
steps.observed: Building type 22 asserted in city snapshot

steps.step: Choose Port and click generated coast entrance
steps.expected: Permitted Coastal port; hull and dock edits exist
steps.observed: Permit notice, carrier hull and water beside berth asserted

steps.step: Click the same coastal entrance again
Inspect carrier from two camera angles
steps.expected: Hull, cargo, bridge and funnel are visible

steps.step: Place a second coastal port through the menu
Follow the rendered sailing carrier with real city time
steps.expected: Ship changes position by more than 2 blocks
Ship reaches destination anchorage and waits
steps.observed: Position within 0.1 block of destination and sailing() == false asserted

steps.expected: Ship begins its return voyage after dwell
steps.observed: sailing() == true and Z > destination Z + 1 asserted

steps.step: Exit game and reload the synthetic save
steps.expected: Ports and automatic service remain available
steps.observed: Port persistence and exactly one restored ship asserted

playtest.saveReload: Port permits and automatic shipping service restored after game shutdown/reload.
playtest.observedPerformance: Native software-rendered captures showed 1-3 FPS; this run measures correctness.

mediaValidation.source: production F10 recorder in native container carrier and port route playtest

mediaInspection: Inspected fresh sailing, bridge and destination arrival PNGs and the decoded final video sample. Colored container stacks, stepped hull, bridge, funnel and port-side arrival are visible.
